patch.value: Enforce the configured statement coverage threshold in the package gate

package.json declares coverageGate.thresholds.statements=100, but scripts/coverage-gate.ts forwards only line, branch and function thresholds to the native Node test runner. The runner exposes no statement metric, so a green coverage command cannot substantiate the mandated 100/100/100/100 claim. The new numerical adapter was independently measured with c8, but whole-package statement coverage remains unmeasured. This is a package gate issue, not an upstream CLI or SDK defect.

Every configured coverage dimension is actually measured and enforced across every authored runtime source; a failing statement threshold rejects the gate; omitted sources and existing line branch function regressions still reject; complete real package tests report exact four-dimensional totals without exclusions or lowered thresholds
